general_information.Description: This course is a follow-up to FIN202 and IBF301, in which students touch on fundamental concepts of finance in general and corporate finance in particular. After the theoretical foundation established in FIN202 and IBF301, students now have chance to acquire indepth knowledge about Derivatives valuation and investment strategies. Topics include: Futures and Forwards Valuation and Strategies, Option Valuation and Strategies, Swaps, Financial Risk Management.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfil tasks given by intructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (http://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

description: This course is a follow-up to FIN202 and IBF301, in which students touch on fundamental concepts of finance in general and corporate finance in particular. learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Gain the essential knowledge and expertise in managing financial risks within the context of international investments, along with an understanding of the tools available for mitigating such risks.

Effectively utilize comprehension of derivatives to tackle issues related to financial risks, specifically those encountered in international investments. This includes addressing challenges such as foreign exchange risk, interest rate risk, credit risk, and portfolio risks.
Make well-informed assessments regarding the utilization of derivative instruments, taking into account the specific requirements and considerations associated with international investments.
Recognize and evaluate the influence of significant advancements in the literature pertaining to derivatives, particularly in relation to their impact on the field of international investments.
Recognize and practice a commitment to professional ethical standard.
Display teamwork and conduct task both independently and collaboratively

assessments.Note: Participation grade will be given based on students' preparation, quantity as well as quality of participation in classroom; quality of participation is demonstrated through asking relevant questions, making statements that add to and facilitate class discussion, and builds upon others’ comments.
